User has to choose one user/group from the specified list Notes Flags Some codes are marked as flags and it is stated that the column value can contain a combination of these flags. This is possible, because each code corresponds to exactly 1 bit in the binary representation of a number, e.g.: Decimal value  Binary value

10000000 To decode a specific value (e.g.: 99), convert the value into its binary representation (in this case: 01100011). In the binary value one can easily see that the value 99 is built from the flags 64+32+2+1. So, these four flags are combined in this one value. Therefore DB Codes 19
